name: HH breakout 03 — squeeze-expansion ATR-normalized break (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same volatility-clustering forecast (a compressed coil forecasts expansion), but measured on a SLOWER 4h clock so the coil is a multi-week compression and the resolved trend can run for days — a genuinely different holding regime from the 1h variants, not just a re-parametrization. Gate on bb_width compressed AND vol_realized compressed, enter long on a range_position up-break, and add an atr FLOOR so we only take breaks where the true-range has begun to widen (the expansion is actually underway, not a single-bar poke into a dead coil). adx confirms the trend. The 4h clock means fees are paid only on real regime changes. Counterparty: the same short-gamma vol-sellers who must hedge the expansion, plus slow range-faders shorting the multi-week high. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the atr floor is decorative (removing it does not degrade the edge → we are just buying breakouts, not expansions), or if the post-break distribution is symmetric with mean within a fee-round-trip of zero net of fees, or if the 4h edge is a pre-2024 artifact that the 2025 holdout does not reproduce.
catalyst: multi-week coil breaks UP with true-range already widening
